definitions.short: properly, to vanquish ; by implication, to rule (causatively, crown)
definitions.usage: make princes, have power, reign. See 5493 .
definitions.full: H7786. sur [ שָׂרַר ] verb denominative (Gerber 20 ) be, or act as, prince, rule ; — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׂרָאֵל עַלֿ וַיָּ֫שַׂר Judg 9:22 Abimelech ruled over Israel three years; 3 masculine plural יָשׂ֑רוּ ֗֗֗ שָׂרִים Isa 32:1 princes shall govern (prince it) justly (|| יִמְלָךְמֶֿלֶךְ ), compare Prov 8:16 ; Participle שׂרֵר לִהְיוֺת֗֗֗ Est 1:22 that every man should bear rule בְּבֵיתוֺ . Hithpa`el Imperfect , 2 masculine singular + Infinitive absolute גַּםהִֿשְׂתָּרֵר עָלֵינוּ כִּיתִֿשְׂתָּרֵר Num 16:13 that thou shouldst also keep playing the prince over us. — יָסֹר 1Chr 15:22 see יָסַר Qal and שַׂר 4b. Hiph`il Perfect 3plural metaplastic הֵשִׂירוּ (Ges § 67v ) Hosea 8:4 they made princes (absolute; || הִמְלִיכוּ ). p. 415f, 978
